company.name: Bouncer
company.shortDescription: The most intelligent email verification, to keep you from bounced back emails.
company.description:
Bouncer gives a possibility to perform an email verification via API regardless whether it is just one email address or tons of them.

We believe that by providing intelligent email verification we are able to secure uninterrupted communication between Talents and Skills with The Needs.

Our aim is to:
- protect your sender's reputation by sanitizing your email addresses' database,
- ensure continuity of the communication with your customers and partners by catching not-existing email addresses in the moment of their entry,
- maximize reach to your customers and partners by segregating low-quality email addresses from those of a high value.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 83 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 48 (-4).
